# PDF Image Studio — Full Documentation for AI Agents

> Comprehensive documentation for PDF Image Studio, a client-side web application for PDF and image manipulation.

## System Capabilities
PDF Image Studio operates entirely in the browser using HTML5 Canvas, WebAssembly, and pdf-lib. All operations run locally inside the client's device memory.

## PDF Tools
- [PDF Page Organizer](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-organizer): Visual drag-and-drop page reordering, page rotation (90, 180, 270 degrees), page deletion, duplication, and extraction.
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/merge-pdf): Reorder multiple PDF files and merge them into a single PDF document.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/split-pdf): Split PDF documents by single pages, custom ranges (e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10), or odd/even pages.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/compress-pdf): Compress PDF documents with customizable quality presets (High, Medium, Low, Extreme).
- [PDF Rotate](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-rotate): Rotate all or selected pages in a PDF document.
- [PDF Watermark](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-watermark): Overlay custom text or image watermarks with opacity, angle, and position controls.
- [PDF Page Numbers](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-page-numbers): Add page numbers with customizable placement, font size, margin, and numbering format.
- [PDF Metadata](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-metadata): View and edit PDF Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, and Producer metadata tags.
- [PDF Flatten](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-flatten): Flatten interactive PDF form fields and annotations into static document content.
- [PDF Redact & Sanitize](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-redact-sanitize): Remove hidden metadata, annotations, attachments, and visual text redaction.
- [Text to PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/text-to-pdf): Convert plain text or markdown formatted text into printable PDF documents.
- [Images to PDF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/images-to-pdf): Convert multiple image files (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a single PDF document with custom margins and page sizes.
- [PDF to Images](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/pdf-to-images): Render PDF pages into high-resolution JPG or PNG images.

## Image Tools
- [Image Compressor](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-compressor): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images with real-time target file size estimate.
- [Image Resizer](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-resizer): Resize images by pixels, percentage, or specific aspect ratio constraints.
- [Image Converter](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-converter): Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, and SVG formats.
- [Image Crop](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-crop): Crop images with preset aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16) or custom bounding boxes.
- [Image Rotate & Flip](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-rotate-flip): Rotate images clockwise/counterclockwise and flip horizontally/vertically.
- [Image Strip EXIF](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-strip-exif): View, inspect, and strip sensitive EXIF metadata (GPS location, camera model, date) from photos.
- [Image Filter Adjust](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-filter-adjust): Apply brightness, contrast, saturation, blur, grayscale, and sepia filters.
- [Image Color Palette](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/image-color-palette): Extract color palettes (HEX, RGB, HSL) from uploaded images.

## Utility Pages
- [All Tools](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/all-tools): Complete directory of all 18+ browser file utilities.
- [Batch Processor](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/batch-processor): Process multiple files across tools in a single unified workspace.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/privacy): Technical architecture whitepaper on client-side security and 100% in-memory execution.
- [About](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/about): Mission statement on replacing ad-heavy cloud file converters with local browser computing.
- [Terms](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/terms): Terms of service.
- [Blog](https://pdfimage.pages.dev/blog): Educational articles and tutorials on PDF and image workflows.
